description: This file defines the PerformanceTrackerDao class which provides data access methods for managing performance tracker entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, updating, deleting, and querying performance trackers and their reviewers, and handles database transactions and query constructions specific to the performance tracking feature.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerDao
classes.description: This class provides data access methods for performance tracker entities, including retrieval, creation, update, deletion, and complex queries involving filters and relationships with reviewers and employees.

methods.name: getPerformanceTracker
methods.description: Retrieves a PerformanceTracker entity by its ID if active (status=1).

methods.name: getExistingPerformanceTrackerIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of existing PerformanceTrackers from a provided list that are not marked as deleted.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackList
methods.description: Fetches a list of PerformanceTrackers based on provided search filters.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerCount
methods.description: Returns the count of PerformanceTrackers matching the search filters.

methods.name: savePerformanceTracker
methods.description: Persists a PerformanceTracker entity and associated reviewers within a transaction.

methods.name: savePerformanceTrackerReviewers
methods.description: Helper method to save reviewer associations for a performance tracker.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Constructs a QueryBuilderWrapper for filtering PerformanceTrackers based on search parameters.

methods.name: deletePerformanceTracker
methods.description: Marks specified PerformanceTrackers as deleted by updating their status.

methods.name: getReviewerListByTrackerId
methods.description: Fetches the list of reviewers associated with a specific performance tracker.

methods.name: updatePerformanceTracker
methods.description: Updates a PerformanceTracker and its reviewers, handling additions and deletions appropriately.

methods.name: deleteExistingReviewers
methods.description: Deletes reviewer associations for a performance tracker based on reviewer IDs.

methods.name: getEmployeeTrackerList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of employee-specific performance trackers based on search filters.

methods.name: getEmployeeTrackerCount
methods.description: Counts performance trackers associated with employees based on filters.

methods.name: getEmployeeTrackerQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds a query wrapper to filter employee performance trackers based on parameters.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerIdList
methods.description: Returns a list of all performance tracker IDs.

methods.name: getTrackerIdsByReviewerId
methods.description: Returns tracker IDs associated with a specific reviewer.

methods.name: getTrackerIdsByEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns tracker IDs associated with a specific employee number.

methods.name: getEmployeeIdsByReviewerId
methods.description: Returns employee numbers that are reviewers for a specific reviewer ID.

methods.name: isTrackerReviewer
methods.description: Checks if a given employee number is assigned as a reviewer to any tracker.

methods.name: isTrackerOwnerEditable
methods.description: Checks whether a performance tracker is editable based on its log entries.
